defective_pattern: Misapplying the 3-column measurement model rule (ردیف, متغیر, مؤلفه) to structural path / mediation tables.
why_defective: Structural paths represent relationships between variables, not nested hierarchical constructs. Forcing a measurement model layout onto structural equations obfuscates the path logic and creates nonsensical tables.
observed_symptoms: Structural paths split into separate variable and subscale columns inappropriately.
corrective_remedy: Use a dedicated path column ('مسیر ساختاری / اثر غیرمستقیم') for structural mediation tables instead of the 3-column measurement rule.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect if a structural path table uses measurement columns (ردیف, متغیر, مؤلفه).
